Membership removals

The staged batch orphan_membership_removals.txt, rendered so it can be judged before it delivers. Nothing here has been sent to Wikidata by this page's own doing; delivery is governed by wikidata_editing_lockout.state, which at build time said wikidata editing not locked.

390shrines affected
396statements actually removed
59lists involved
0lose more than one statement
0have no P460 entry
What each line does. It removes a part of statement from a modern shrine pointing into a 神名帳 list. Membership belongs to the register entry; the modern shrine says P460 → entry instead. An item holding both is import damage.

The removal is value-matched, so it takes every matching statement on that item — which is intended: "every single membership thing on those items should be removed unless the membership of the Shikinaisha list is 100% accurate and is 100% what we want. We remove it and then we add it again." The statements removed column is that count, and it is the thing a QuickStatements line hides. Re-adding correct membership is the separate later job.

Rows with no P460 are the ones worth a second look: without it, the claim that the item is a modern shrine rather than a register entry rests on the list correspondence alone.
